relations.myth: Michael executes divine commands and judgment
relations.note: Michael serves God, petitions him, receives commands, intercedes, and executes judgment.
Jewish, Christian, and Islamic traditions generally regard Michael as directly created by God.
Michael aids the interpreting angel, traditionally identified as Gabriel, against Persia's prince.

other_aliases: prince of the kingdom of Persia
relations.note: Michael intervenes against Persia's celestial prince after the latter obstructs the interpreting angel.
Michael supports the interpreting angel against Greece's approaching prince, though their combat is only anticipated.
Michael and Raphael jointly petition God and receive commissions against the Watchers and cosmic corruption.
Michael and Gabriel jointly petition God and receive distinct punitive commissions.
Michael and Uriel or Sariel jointly petition God and receive divine commissions.
Michael is commanded to bind the Watcher leader and his associates for seventy generations.
Michael stands among the heavenly presences attending judgment associated with the Elect One.

relations.myth: Eschatological war of light and darkness
relations.note: Michael appears in fragments related to the war against Belial, though no personal duel survives.
Michael opposes or restrains Mastema's demonic accusation in recension-dependent later Jewish traditions.
Michael disputes with the Devil over Moses' corpse and invokes the Lord's rebuke.
Michael and his angels defeat the dragon's army and expel it from heaven.
Michael conveys God's commands while personified Death finally brings about Abraham's death.
After Saklataboth rebels and falls, Michael is invested in the fallen being's former office.
Michael serves Christ and participates in his celestial retinue and, in some recensions, his descent and ascent.
Some Adventist and related Protestant interpretations identify Michael as a title or heavenly identity of Christ.
Jehovah's Witnesses teach that Michael is Jesus' heavenly name before and after his earthly life.
Michael escorts or protects Mary's soul and body in later Dormition and Assumption traditions.

relations.myth: Named angels opposed by God's enemies
relations.note: Michael and Gabriel are named together as angels whose enemies are God's enemies.
Michael and Gabriel are jointly invoked as angels under God's lordship.
Michael and Isrāfīl are jointly invoked as angels under God's lordship.
Michael commands loyal angels against Lucifer during Milton's elaborated war in heaven.
Michael and Raphael occupy the southern and eastern quarters respectively in Golden Dawn ritual.
Michael and Gabriel occupy the southern and western quarters respectively in Golden Dawn ritual.
Michael and Uriel occupy the southern and northern quarters respectively in Golden Dawn ritual.
